requirement: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long and contain an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a digit; passwords violating these rules are rejected.
source_headline: Removed password validation rules (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit)
label: GAP
reasoning: There is no code validating password complexity or length in either create_user() or change_password(). The service accepts any provided password and only hashes it via hash_password(), so a test expecting rejection of passwords shorter than 8 characters or missing uppercase/lowercase/digit would fail because the behavior is absent entirely.
